protocol.unit: image; sampled within each observed center, paired across all supplied models
protocol.center_composition: fixed at original counts in each replicate; conditional on the six observed centers
protocol.limitations: No verified patient/video mapping. Image dependence may make intervals optimistic; not patient-level uncertainty or training-seed uncertainty. Multiple metric intervals are exploratory, not multiplicity-adjusted hypothesis tests.
protocol.interval: percentile 2.5/97.5; AP recalculated from every resampled multiset
